Preview the levels in a parsed Eprime file

Source: R/preview.R
preview_eprime.Rd

Preview the levels in a parsed Eprime file

Usage

preview_eprime(frame_list)

preview_levels(frame_list)

preview_frames(frame_list)

Arguments

frame_list

a FrameList() object (a list of EprimeFrame() objects)

Value

The input FrameList() object, invisibly. Preview text is printed to the console.

Details

preview_levels() prints out the unique combinations of Eprime.Level number, Procedure, and Running in the frame list. preview_frames() prints out an example frame from each of the unique levels. preview_eprime() does both.

Examples

data <- read_eprime(example_eprime_file("MINP")) |>
  FrameList() |>
  preview_eprime()
